SUSE-SU-2026:3269-1 fixes only CVE-2026-41991: insecure temp-file handling in the gzexe utility when mktemp is not in PATH (local, SUSE CVSS 6.9). The Calico image never invokes gzexe; gzip is a base BCI OS package and is not used by the Calico binaries at runtime, so the vulnerable code path is unreachable.. This statement concerns SUSE-SU-2026:3269-1 in pkg:rpm/suse/gzip as a subcomponent of pkg:oci/hardened-calico?repository_url=index.docker.io/rancher/hardened-calico. SUSE-SU-2026:3341-1 fixes six glib2 OOB-read/integer-overflow issues (CVE-2026-58010/58011/58012/58013/58014/58016) in GVariant, GDateTime, GRegex, GIOChannel, GKeyFile and GDBus introspection parsing. glib2 is only a transitive dependency of BCI base tooling; it is not linked into or used by the statically-linked Calico Go binaries or BIRD/runit, and none of the affected GLib APIs are reachable at runtime.. This statement concerns SUSE-SU-2026:3341-1 in pkg:rpm/suse/libglib-2_0-0 as a subcomponent of pkg:oci/hardened-calico?repository_url=index.docker.io/rancher/hardened-calico.
